reviews.text: Ight creamy texture melts in minutes and offers full coverage from sun. Doesn’t sting your eyes and has no strong scent.
reviews.zh: 質感幼滑，幾分鐘內就融入皮膚，可以全面防曬。唔會刺眼，又冇乜味。

reviews.text: The Mixsoon Bean Sun Serum has a lightweight texture that feels comfortable on the skin and absorbs quickly without leaving a white cast. It gives a natural hydrated finish and works well for everyday wear. The formula feels gentle and layers nicely under makeup without feeling too heavy or greasy.
reviews.zh: Mixsoon Bean Sun Serum 質地輕盈，上皮膚舒服，吸收快，唔會泛白。妝效係自然保濕，日常用好啱。配方溫和，喺妝前打底幾層都唔會覺得厚重或者油笠。

reviews.text: I love that this doesn't irritate my sensitive skin like some other sun creams. There is also no white cast when putting on which is a great plus.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意佢冇刺激到我嘅敏感肌膚，同其他防曬唔同。搽完都唔會泛白，呢點真係加分。

reviews.text: Me encanta mixsoon! El protector solar es prometedor y no he tenido ningún contratiempo con este, la textura es buena y se siente bien en el rostro
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意 mixsoon！防曬表現有驚喜，用咗都冇出過咩問題，質地好，搽上面都好舒服。

reviews.text: This is my holy grail sunscream. Very hydrating, and occlusive to skincare serums beneath to trap your molecules on or in your skin beneath, without being overbearing and causing a thick, greasy, unbreathable buildup. Thin and lightweight. It feels as if it sinks into your skin. It has no fragrance–will not interfere with any scents you layer! It may be minimalist but it is extremely durable as well. As an American, I prefer a matte, almost "baby powder" look and finish, so the satiny, dewy finish "chok-chok" is not my favorite, especially since my skin is already very shiny on its own. So I look very, very bright and reflective with this. But the ferments within (they hydrate and gently lighten skin tone) are quality skincare ingredients, and the formulation is simply top-tier, that I love it too much, so I wear it anyways! The dewy finish settled down after 30 minutes a bit anyways! Reapplying several times daily does not cause buildup unlike some other SPF. My everlasting fave!
reviews.zh: 呢枝係我嘅防曬聖物。非常保濕，而且可以鎖住下面護膚精華嘅分子，等佢哋留喺皮膚表面或者入面，唔會過份厚重，搞到一層厚厚、油笠、透唔到氣嘅堆積。薄身輕盈，感覺好似滲入皮膚一樣。冇香味——唔會同你之後疊加嘅任何香氣有衝突！雖然包裝簡約，但非常耐用。作為美國人，我鍾意霧面、近似「爽身粉」嘅妝效，所以呢種絲滑水光「chok-chok」妝效唔係我最愛，尤其我本身皮膚已經好有光澤。搽完之後望落會非常、非常亮同反光。但入面嘅發酵成分（可以保濕同溫和提亮膚色）係優質護膚成分，配方簡直係頂級，所以我太鍾意，照樣用住先！水光妝效過咗 30 分鐘都會稍微減退！同其他 SPF 唔同，就算一日補搽幾次都唔會有堆積感。永遠嘅最愛！

reviews.text: A sunscreen to keep in my rotation. I love the texture and the way it soaks in without leaving behind a residue or feeling of heaviness.
reviews.zh: 一枝會輪住用嘅防曬。鍾意佢嘅質地，吸收得好快，唔會留低殘留物或者厚重感。

reviews.text: This product has a really amazing formula feeling, not my favorite because I like for sunscreen to leave my face looking whiter but if you like to keep your natural skin color and no white cast this would be a great option for you.
reviews.zh: 呢個產品嘅配方觸感真係好正，但唔係我最鍾意嘅，因為我自己鍾意防曬搽完塊面白啲。如果你鍾意保留自然膚色、唔想泛白，呢枝會係一個好選擇。

reviews.text: Perfect, just perfect. I have a lot of issues with sun creams clogging my pores and making me break out, and this does not cause any of those issues. The texture is really great too.
reviews.zh: 完美，真係完美。我用好多防曬都會塞毛孔同爆瘡，但呢枝完全冇呢啲問題。質地亦都好正。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
